summary: Live Nation Entertainment filed an 8-K reporting the October 15, 2026 close of a private offering of $730.0 million 7.125% senior notes due 2032 and €600.0 million 6.125% senior notes due 2032, governed by an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. Net proceeds fund full redemption of the 6.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2027 plus fees and general corporate purposes. Cross-currency swaps convert the dollar notes into roughly €652.1 million at about 5.68%, bringing the weighted average rate to approximately 5.89%. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
